Simple 3-Step Process

How It Works

From first enquiry to hands-on session on campus, we keep coordination seamless and transparent for educators.

  1. 01Step 1

    Send an enquiry

    Tell us your institution, the class groups and the dates that suit you.

  2. 02Step 2

    Plan with an advisor

    A programme advisor gets back to you to discuss dates, class groups and what the session would cover.

  3. 03Step 3

    Run the session

    Students build, test and solve real problems at your campus with guided support.
